readme.html:
ae-agent-skills

Edit After Effects projects with Codex, Gemini, or Claude Code using py-aep. The installer includes the agent skill, Python environment, ae-cli, ae-generative, and After Effects extension.

日本語: README.ja.md

Install

Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.10+ with venv. Full installation supports macOS; on Linux, add --skip-extension for offline editing and rendering. The npm installer does not support Windows.

npx --yes ae-agent-skills@latest install --agent codex

Replace codex with gemini, claude, or all. The installer downloads the Python packages and Chromium into ~/.local/share/ae-agent-skills/.

For live After Effects operations, restart After Effects and open Window > Extensions (Beta) > ae-agent-skill.

Usage

Launch your agent and describe the edit:

Use $aftereffects-py-aep to add a title to the Main composition in
/path/to/input.aep and save it as /path/to/output.aep.

In Claude Code, use /aftereffects-py-aep instead of $aftereffects-py-aep.

To create animation from HTML, Canvas, SVG, or WebGL:

Use $aftereffects-py-aep to create a 5-second floating-icons animation in Canvas,
render it as a PNG sequence, and add it to the Main composition in
/path/to/input.aep. Save it as /path/to/output.aep.

To run commands directly, add the installed launchers to your PATH and restart your agent:

export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/ae-agent-skills/bin:$PATH"
ae-generative render /path/to/scene --output /path/to/new-render
"$HOME/.local/share/ae-agent-skills/bin/python" /path/to/task.py

Start your scene from the example. Use a new output directory and trusted local code. To change the rendered artwork, edit the scene source and render again. If Chromium setup failed, run ae-generative setup.

Update

Quit After Effects and rerun the install command for your agent, then restart After Effects.

skills.name: aftereffects-cli
skills.description: Command-by-command After Effects editing and inspection via ae-cli, including PNG snapshots, comp-layer assembly, footage cuts, audio changes, whole-layer text styling, and visual-bounds alignment or distribution. Best for surgical edits, visual verification, and debugging of existing scenes.

skills.name: aftereffects-declarative
skills.description: Primary After Effects workflow using ae-cli apply-scene with declarative JSON (composition/assets/comp layers/footage cuts/audio/text styles/layout/layers/animations/expressions/parent/repeater/effect params). Use this by default for composition building and repeatable footage, audio, text, or visua

skills.name: aftereffects-py-aep
skills.description: Edit, inspect, create, and validate After Effects .aep projects offline with py-aep, without opening After Effects for file-level work. Use for existing AEP template edits, composition/layer/property/keyframe/text/shape/footage/render-queue changes, batch processing, new AEP creation, or code-author
